policy: Canary enterprise support policy requires the first response within eleven hours on weekends. This is a first-response target, not a resolution deadline.
limitations: Native noninteractive CLI sessions only. Does not establish interactive or desktop UI trust, Windows behavior, startup, model quality, or installer acceptance.
trust: Invocation-local generated hook; one-shot trust bypass; user config ignored; plugins disabled; experimental host-skill-discovery suppression
